Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of needs (as I understood them)
- Primary use case: structured extraction + downstream tool calls (createTicket, enrichEntity) from support transcripts and multi-turn dialogs.
- Success criteria: >=95% JSON-schema compliance on structured outputs, <150ms 95th percentile latency for single-turn tool call opens, and consistent behavior under retry (idempotency).
- Constraints: data residency in us-west, cannot send PII out of their VPC for initial eval, and procurement will require an MA/Quote.

Recommended short evaluation plan (what Redwood will run / provide)
1) Model shortlist for model-fit runs (we'll evaluate both hosted and private/DED flavors):
   - redwood-instruct-1.0 (commercially tuned for instruction + structured output)
   - llama-3-70b-q4_k_m (quantized candidate for cost/latency trade-off)
   - falcon-40b-instruct (fast decoder baseline)
2) Structured-output tests: 1k prompts sampled from your anonymized transcript set (you mentioned ~10k records; if you can share a 1k sample we'll start there). We'll validate against the attached response_schema.json and measure schema-violations / partial outputs.
3) Tool-calling verification: run function-calling scenarios (createTicket, enrichEntity) with explicit function signatures; assert call/no-call decisions and payload conformity; test retry window and idempotency markers.
4) Benchmarks: latency (p50/p95), cost-per-1k-tokens, schema-compliance rate, and hallucination rate on entity fields.

Deliverables
- Results CSV with per-prompt pass/fail, error type, latency and tokens.
- Summary deck + suggested rollout: canary config (10% traffic) -> A/B fallback rules -> full rollout.
- MA Plan draft + expected pricing options (hosted vs dedicated).

Attachments: acme-ma-plan-v1.pdf (draft), acme-eval-prompt-sets.csv (sample prompts), response_schema.json (schema we propose).

Next concrete steps
- Sam/Priya: confirm whether you can provide a 1k anonymized sample (S3 link or Drive) and which evaluation mode you prefer (hosted sandbox vs Redwood Private in your VPC).
- We (Redwood): Hannah to run the initial structured-output validator against the sample, Jordan to prepare the benchmark harness and pricing delta for Dedicated. I will assemble MA Plan and schedule a technical demo with SRE/security one week out.

Proposed times for the demo: Thu 6/18 or Mon 6/22 (PST).
